pulse.text: **Quiet two hours** — nothing shipped since the 10AM sweep and the leaderboard is unchanged: **Claude Opus 4.8 still leads the AA Index (v4.1) at 56**, ahead of GPT-5.5 (55), Claude Sonnet 5 (53) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (46). The one live mover is the **GPT-5.6 broad-GA clock**: OpenAI's Sol/Terra/Luna suite is still gated to ~20 US-government-vetted orgs, but Polymarket's daily markets now price a **public flip as soon as July 7 (~64%)**, with 'released by Jul 31' holding **~96%** — the first broad frontier drop since the government-gating regime could land within days. The best-model races are static: **Anthropic holds 91%** to own the top model at end-of-July and **64%** for end-of-2026 (Google 14%), while **GPT-6 by Dec 31 eased to 70%** (Sep 30 ~28%). Google's **Gemini 3.5 Pro remains stuck in Vertex preview**, having now missed both its June I/O promise and its June 30 GA target. Watch next: whether OpenAI opens GPT-5.6 to the public this week — the only real jolt on an otherwise flat holiday-week tape.
